steps.title: A low Sun
steps.body: The Moon is barely tilted, so the Sun stays low at the pole.

steps.title: It circles
steps.body: Play the skyline. The Sun circles instead of rising high.

steps.title: Long shadows
steps.body: A 1 m rock throws a shadow about 38 m long when the Sun is 1.5° up.

steps.title: Ridge and floor
steps.body: Ridges stay bright. Crater floors stay dark.

steps.title: Talking to Earth
steps.body: Earth moves above and below the horizon. That is when the mission can talk to Earth.

steps.title: Read the result
steps.body: Try a date. Read the result card.
